MatrixPolicy.description: Explicit diagnostic work and numerical classification limits.

dense_entries.description: Includes dense input and both complete singular-vector factors/Gram products.

findings.description: Maximum parallel row and column pairs reported before the analysis is refused.

parallel_tolerance.description: Pairs with `1 - |cosine|` at or below this are reported as parallel; in [0, 1).

rank_absolute.description: Absolute singular-value cutoff for numerical rank.

rank_relative.description: Singular-value cutoff relative to the largest singular value; in [0, 1).

singular_vector.description:
Magnitude above which a row or column's component of a singular vector below the
rank cutoff names it as a member of that near-null mode; in [0, 1).

ModelingDiagnosticPolicy.description: Explicit thresholds and budgets; the caller selects the named knowledge profile.

bound_violation.description: Bound violation above which a value is outside its bound.

jacobian_large.description: Normalized Jacobian magnitude above which an entry, row or column is large.

jacobian_small.description: Normalized Jacobian magnitude below which a nonzero entry, row or column is small.

matrix.description: Dense matrix analysis budgets and tolerances.

maximum_findings.description: Finding budget; further findings leave the report incomplete.

near_bound_absolute.description: Absolute part of the near-bound distance.

near_bound_relative.description: Relative part of the near-bound distance, times the larger of the bound and nominal.

profile.description: Name of the knowledge profile these thresholds come from.

residual.description: Row residual, relative to the row nominal, above which it is large.

terms.description: Equation term analysis budgets and tolerances.

variable_large.description: Normalized magnitude above which a value is large.

variable_small.description: Normalized magnitude below which a nonzero value is small.

variable_zero.description: Normalized magnitude at or below which a value counts as zero.

TermPolicy.description: Bounded examination of original signed additive terms, before simplification.

cancellation.description: Normalized subset sum at or below which the subset is reported as cancelling.

findings.description: Maximum number of cancelling subsets reported.

maximum_terms.description: Largest subset size examined for cancellation, from 2 to 32.

mismatch.description: Ratio to the largest magnitude beyond which a smaller term is reported as mismatched.

zero.description: Magnitude at or below which a term is treated as zero and not examined.

description: Source-owned conformance limits and selected fixtures.

fixtures.description: Explicit fixture occurrences, or the package selection when omitted.

maximum_fixtures.description: Maximum fixtures admitted by this operation.

title: ConformanceControls
